parameters.name: sha
parameters.description: SHA or branch to start listing commits from (usually 'master')

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only commits after this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only commits before this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: include diff stats for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')

parameters.name: verification
parameters.description: include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number of results to return (1-based)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size of results (ignored if used with 'path')

parameters.name: not
parameters.description: commits that match the given specifier will not be listed.

Token.name: token
Token.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AccessToken.name: access_token
AccessToken.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AuthorizationHeaderToken.name: Authorization
AuthorizationHeaderToken.description: API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.

SudoParam.name: sudo
SudoParam.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

SudoHeader.name: Sudo
SudoHeader.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

TOTPHeader.name: X-GITEA-OTP
TOTPHeader.description: Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.
